message.content:
A red magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large black letters features an illustration of several people against a red background. At the top, white text reads "DISKRIMINASI AGAMA-AGAMA LOKAL" and "BIANG KELADI KEBAKARAN HUTAN RIAU." Below the title, the date "27 OKTOBER-2 NOVEMBER 2014" is printed. Large white block letters in the center read "MIMPI KABINET IMPIAN."

The illustration depicts a central man with dark, thinning hair, a tired expression, and downturned eyes. Four other figures surround him, leaning in closely. To his left, a man with a wide-open mouth appears to be shouting into the central man’s ear. To the right, a woman with short dark hair and glasses smiles while holding a rolled-up piece of paper featuring a small face. In the lower left, a woman with dark hair leans towards the central man, and in the lower right, the back of a person’s head and shoulder are visible. All figures wear white shirts. Hands are raised toward the central man’s face. A barcode and price "RP 35.000" are in the bottom right corner.
